subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To break into tears.
solution:
The correct answer is 'To cry suddenly'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• To break into tears is an idiom that means to **suddenly begin to cry**.

 
 
• ​Example - *My mother was fine this morning, but she **broke into tears** at the funeral.*
 
 
 
• So, to cry suddenly is the **most appropriate meaning** of the given idiom.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the **correct answer.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 Let's look at the meaning of the other options - 

 
• To fidget: This means to make small movements, often due to anxiety, impatience or nervousness.
 
• To panic: This refers to sudden, uncontrollable fear or anxiety.
 
• To be afraid of: This pertains to feeling fear, dread or unease.
